headline: Messi assists in Inter Miami draw with Atlanta United after Argentina retirement
summary: Lionel Messi provided a key assist in a 2-2 draw, marking his first club game since retiring from international duty.
details: Lionel Messi provided an assist in Inter Miami's 2-2 draw with Atlanta United in Florida on Sunday.
This was the Argentine's first appearance since retiring from international duty earlier this week.
Messi whipped in a corner that Casemiro headed in to put Miami ahead in the 32nd minute.
Atlanta United responded quickly, with Miguel Almiron leveling the score just three minutes later.
Luis Suarez restored Miami's lead before halftime, but Breel Embolo converted an 87th-minute penalty to earn Atlanta a point.
Messi is currently joint top of the MLS scoring charts with 18 goals this season.
The 39-year-old had previously expressed doubts about his playing career following the death of his father, Jorge, on August 8.
caption:
Messi is back on the pitch! After retiring from international duty, the legend provides an assist in a dramatic 2-2 draw.

Lionel Messi provided an assist in Inter Miami's 2-2 draw with Atlanta United in Florida on Sunday.

This was the Argentine's first appearance since retiring from international duty earlier this week.

Messi whipped in a corner that Casemiro headed in to put Miami ahead in the 32nd minute.

Atlanta United responded quickly, with Miguel Almiron leveling the score just three minutes later.

Luis Suarez restored Miami's lead before halftime, but Breel Embolo converted an 87th-minute penalty to earn Atlanta a point.

Messi is currently joint top of the MLS scoring charts with 18 goals this season.

The 39-year-old had previously expressed doubts about his playing career following the death of his father, Jorge, on August 8.

headline: Police SB member beaten to death in Savar after protesting assault
summary: A 57-year-old Special Branch sub-inspector was killed and his son critically injured after intervening in an attack on an elderly auto-rickshaw driver.
details: Md Altaf Hossain, a 57-year-old sub-inspector of the Special Branch (SB) of police, was beaten to death in the Janata Housing area of Aminbazar, Savar, around 10:00 pm yesterday.
The incident occurred when Altaf Hossain saw several youths in a private car assaulting an elderly auto-rickshaw driver near his residence.
According to the police, Altaf protested the assault, which led the youths to turn on him and begin beating him.
Altaf attempted to save himself by running into his garment factory, but the attackers, calling 15-20 others, stormed the factory and vandalized machinery.
The attackers allegedly beat Altaf and his son, Md Arif, until they were unconscious before fleeing the scene.
Neighbours took the victims to Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital, where doctors declared Altaf dead on arrival.
His son, Md Arif, remains in critical condition and is undergoing treatment at the hospital.
Savar Model Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Md Saiful Alam stated that efforts are underway to identify and arrest those involved in the attack.
caption:
A police officer was beaten to death for simply protesting the assault of an elderly driver.

Md Altaf Hossain, a 57-year-old sub-inspector of the Special Branch (SB) of police, was beaten to death in the Janata Housing area of Aminbazar, Savar, around 10:00 pm yesterday.

The incident occurred when Altaf Hossain saw several youths in a private car assaulting an elderly auto-rickshaw driver near his residence.

According to the police, Altaf protested the assault, which led the youths to turn on him and begin beating him.

Altaf attempted to save himself by running into his garment factory, but the attackers, calling 15-20 others, stormed the factory and vandalized machinery.

The attackers allegedly beat Altaf and his son, Md Arif, until they were unconscious before fleeing the scene.

Neighbours took the victims to Shaheed Suhrawardy Medical College Hospital, where doctors declared Altaf dead on arrival.

His son, Md Arif, remains in critical condition and is undergoing treatment at the hospital.

Savar Model Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Md Saiful Alam stated that efforts are underway to identify and arrest those involved in the attack.
